commitSubject: Drive opacity in the byte it is drawn with
change: Opacity slider driven in drawn bytes; readout derived from the byte. UI only, no renderer change.
treeBuildFieldsProvenance: Observed at deploy time from the tree build.
normalisedSource: Computed from the preserved DEPLOYED bytes.
freshness: plugin target rebuilt separately after the tests; 2383 assertions / 94 cases green

pdbLink.method: SECONDARY sanity check only; byte identity is primary

symbolsContainer: PDB. C++ symbol names live in the .pdb, NOT the .dll - probing the DLL returns 0 for all of them and that 0 is not evidence the record is false. Counts must match EXACTLY, not >=.
mutationProof: Putting the float comparison back inside PermitMask fails test_overlay_alpha.cpp:56 and :68. The new all-256-bytes case fails if Byte stops being truncating.
mutationProofProvenance: The slider widget itself is NOT reachable from the headless suite: restoring "%.0f%%" in the SliderInt format still passes. The guard is on the byte property, not on the widget.
whatThisDoesNotProve: Not cross-machine reproducible: no scratch-worktree rebuild of this commit was run. Also the new tests cannot see the ImGui widget, only the arithmetic it relies on.
whyThisExists: A hash records the bytes shipped, not that they came from the intended source.
backupHolds: PRE-deployment files. backup DLL is deliberately NOT equal to dllSHA256; a mismatch means the backup worked.
whyDeployedCopyExists: Every earlier deploy survives an install overwrite because a later backup/ holds it. The newest had no such record, so its bytes lived only in the live install. Copy live DLL/PDB to deployed/ at each deploy; never move that directory.
treeBuildPDBSHA256Provenance: LOST at this deploy: the deploy script stopped writing this field here. Not observed as a tree-build value, and the preserved deployed PDB at deployed/HelmetOverlaysNG.pdb (A49E8210...) is the DEPLOYED artefact, not the tree build, so it does not answer this field. Null means lost from the schema, not a failed comparison.

postHocAnnotations.note: Added 2026-10-31T22:53:05+00:00 by HONG after the record was written, when a checker finally read the records. No measurement was invented: this string explains an existing null, and the null and every hash in the record are unchanged.
